title: Harness Eval Case
description: A single eval case for an OpenCode agent or skill.

description.description: What observable behavior this eval verifies.

agent.description: The agent or skill under test (e.g. @tdd, brainstorming).

input.description: The prompt or scenario to feed the agent.

expected_behavior.description: Observable behaviors the output must satisfy.

expected_string.description: Required when pass_criteria is 'output contains expected string'. The substring that must appear in stdout for the case to pass.

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering (e.g. smoke, tdd, critical).
